articles.title: Chicago Cubs lose 8-0 to Padres in wild-card series Game 1
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs’ postseason turned into a nightmare almost immediately in an 8-0 loss in which they were held to three hits during Game 1 of the wild-card series against the San Diego Padres.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs quickly KO’d from playoffs after bats quiet again in 4-1 loss to San Diego Padres
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs were eliminated from an NL wild-card series against the San Diego Padres, falling 4-1 late Wednesday. The Cubs had only one extra-base hit in the two-game sweep.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs set NL wild-card series roster: Pitchers Caleb Thielbar and Edward Cabrera left off
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs opted for 12 pitchers in the best-of-three series, with the most notable exclusions being Caleb Thielbar and Edward Cabrera.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs turn to veteran Kevin Gausman — whose shoulder feels ‘good enough’ — to start in must-win Game 2
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs tried to give Kevin Gausman ample time to recover before turning to 35-year-old for the Game 2 start Wednesday night facing elimination against the San Diego Padres.

articles.title: Matthew Boyd named Chicago Cubs’ Game 1 starter to set up wild-card rematch against the San Diego Padres
articles.description: Matthew Boyd, who got the Game 1 start in last year’s wild-card series against the San Diego Padres, will again get the ball when the Chicago Cubs open their rematch Tuesday, this time at Petco Park.

articles.title: Chicago Media Report: Jarrett Payton’s 1st month at The Score — and an ex-Cubs radio voice up for Hall of Fame
articles.description: The latest Chicago Media Report tackles Jarrett Payton’s first month on The Score, the debut of “The Late Show” set at the Museum of Broadcast Communications, and more.

articles.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong — with ‘more to prove’ — is eager to help Chicago Cubs start the postseason strong
articles.description: This postseason brings different expectations for the presumed National League MVP, though Pete Crow-Armstrong said he’s treating the playoffs as a clean slate.

articles.title: Column: White Sox welcoming Cubs fans to hop on the playoff bandwagon … with a few caveats
articles.description: Now that the Cubs have bowed out of the postseason and the White Sox are in the ALDS, is it time for detente in the intense Chicago baseball rivalry?

articles.title: Where do the Chicago Cubs go after falling short in the playoffs again? ‘We let it slip away.’
articles.description: After the Chicago Cubs fall short in the playoffs, those within the organization must diagnose what went wrong and look ahead to getting another shot in 2027.

articles.title: 3 Chicago Cubs takeaways from Jed Hoyer’s end-of-season news conference, including his ‘poor job’ building pen
articles.description: Chicago Cubs President Jed Hoyer on Friday took responsibility for the bullpen’s shortcomings and addressed the need to improve the pitching staff.

articles.title: Vintage Chicago Tribune: How the Cubs and White Sox have fared in the postseason since 1906
